title: People Operations & Talent Acquisition Specialist
description: Looking for a proactive People Operations & Talent Acquisition Specialist to drive candidate sourcing, end-to-end recruitment pipelines, employee onboarding, and people culture initiatives.
responsibilities: Manage full-lifecycle recruitment for technical and corporate roles across the organization.
Utilize modern Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and LinkedIn Recruiter for candidate sourcing.
Coordinate seamless candidate interview experiences, offers, and background verification.
Support employee onboarding, performance review cycles, and HRIS recordkeeping in Workday.
requirements: 2+ years experience in recruiting, talent acquisition, or human resources.
Hands-on experience with modern ATS platforms (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday).
Strong understanding of employment compliance, employee relations, and benefits.
Exceptional interpersonal communication and organizational skills.
